name: Learning from a reference
description: Use when someone shares a video they like and wants theirs to feel similar: measure its pace, structure, colour and caption style as numbers, and apply them to their own footage. Never copy its pixels, words, music or people.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
